scope: 2D comparison of implementation results with the expected results of the Golden T-Shirt v1 fixture (fixtures/golden-tshirt/v1): evaluated contours and control points, seam lengths, and the control square of 1:1 print output in file coordinates.
notes: FROZEN by maintainer decision on 2026-10-25 with the values unchanged from the provisional proposal (design decisions ADR-017.1 §5 and ADR-025 §6): contour deviation 0.10 mm (Hausdorff distance), relative seam-length deviation 0.5 %, control square 100 mm +/- 0.1 mm in file coordinates (not a physical print). d2p:seam-length-deviation-absolute and d2p:angle-deviation have no adopted value and are omitted. This profile is immutable: a changed limit is a new version, and it is never adjusted to fit an implementation.
